finding.title: Split the 3 settings test files that exceed the 400-line AG-3 limit (866/1255/573 lines)

evidence.quote: // L1 widget tests for SettingsScreen + PointConfigScreen

finding.why: `wc -l` gives 866 / 1255 / 573 lines respectively — 2.2x / 3.1x / 1.4x the 400-line hand-written-Dart ceiling. Files this large are slow to review end-to-end, hide unrelated concerns behind one main(), and make it easier for a reviewer to miss that a change touched an untested branch (as in the A1/A2 gap in the same file).
finding.recommendation: Split each file along its existing group() boundaries — e.g. backup_sync_section_l1_test.dart into a synced/syncing/pending file and a degraded/re-auth file; settings_screen_and_point_config_l1_test.dart per the AG-5 finding above; settings_utils_test.dart into send_logs_service_test.dart plus the (currently missing) account_actions supplement.
acceptance_criteria: `find test -name '*_test.dart' | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400{print}'` no longer lists any of these 3 paths.
A committed Rule-0 checker (e.g. a line-count script wired into `make audit`) fails CI on any hand-written .dart file over 400 lines, since no such checker exists today for AG-3.

finding.title: Move test/core/services/*_test.dart to mirror their real lib/features/scheduler/domain/services/ location (AG-5)
finding.rule: AG-5 — test/ mirrors lib/ 1:1; new source file's test at mirrored path
finding.why: Commits 21e9c357 and f99aee14 (W2.23-W2.25, both 2026-05-20) relocated CalendarProgramRegistry, CalendarProgramService, CrossCurriculumAggregator and LearningProgramService out of lib/core/services/ into lib/features/scheduler/domain/services/, explicitly because core/services/ was 'misplaced' (f99aee14 commit message: 'core/services/ is now empty and removed' — only a .gitkeep now remains). The 5 test files were never moved. test/features/scheduler/domain/services/ already holds ~30 other test files for that exact directory (local_calendar_engine_test.dart, sefaria_ref_matcher_test.dart, pace_calculator_test.dart, etc.) but not these 5 — anyone browsing the mirrored location for coverage of these classes will conclude they're untested and may duplicate it (see the next finding, where that already happened). docs/architecture.md:442 and docs/coding-standards.md:652 still describe lib/core/services/ as the canonical home for cross-curriculum services, actively contradicting the refactor that emptied it.
finding.recommendation: Move all 5 files to test/features/scheduler/domain/services/. Delete lib/core/services/.gitkeep (and the directory) if the core/services/ pattern is retired for good, or update docs/architecture.md and docs/coding-standards.md in the same PR (AG-8) if it should still exist for some future cross-feature service.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 test files exist at test/features/scheduler/domain/services/ and no longer under test/core/services/
docs/architecture.md and docs/coding-standards.md placement guidance for cross-curriculum services matches the actual lib/ layout
A Rule-0 checker for AG-5 (e.g. a script diffing lib/**/*.dart source stems against test/**/*_test.dart stems) exists or is filed as a follow-up
flutter test still green after the move

finding.title: Move TextContent/TextSegment out of text_cache_repository.dart (data layer) into domain/entities/ so presentation and its tests stop importing the data layer
finding.rule: Presentation→data import ban [P]; naming/placement (domain models belong in domain/); Evans lens (bounded-context leak)
finding.why: TextContent/TextSegment are plain immutable data holders — exactly what domain/entities/ is for (that directory exists, scaffolded with a lone .gitkeep, but was never populated) — yet they are defined at the top of text_cache_repository.dart, the DATA-layer repository implementation. That forces text_display_screen.dart (presentation, and a churn HOTSPOT at 1028 lines) to import the data layer just to type its own widget fields (_TextContentView.textContent, _NumberedSegmentColumn.segments). It then forces every test that builds fixture content — 3 of this batch's files (text_display_screen_test.dart, _l1_test.dart, _deep_l1_test.dart) — to do the same, so the test suite faithfully pins the wrong layering instead of catching it. Concrete cost: a presentation test can't get a TextContent value without also pulling in TextCacheRepository's own Drift-DAO-typed constructor surface (the seam Feathers-style testability depends on is gone); a different feature that wanted to render cached text would have to import a repository class to get the model type; and this is a same-feature leak, so it isn't caught by make audit's Rule 1/2 greps (which are scoped to cross-feature imports).
finding.recommendation: Create lib/features/content_browsing/domain/entities/text_content.dart holding TextContent/TextSegment (mechanical move, no behavior change). Update text_cache_repository.dart and text_display_screen.dart (+ its tests) to import the new domain file instead of the repository file.
acceptance_criteria: text_display_screen_l1_test.dart, _deep_l1_test.dart, and text_display_screen_test.dart import domain/entities/text_content.dart, not data/repositories/text_cache_repository.dart, and still pass.
